title: PR-closed workflow: cache deletion must be job-scoped and limited to the PR's merge ref
answers: why does the PR closed workflow need actions write permission
how are caches cleaned up when a pull request closes
which cache refs does the PR closed cleanup delete
why is top-level permissions not granting cache write in pr-closed.yml
body:
Invariant: in .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml, the workflow keeps top-level cache/actions permissions denied; only the delete-caches job sets `actions: write`.
Enforced by: .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml (job delete-caches, permissions block; top-level permissions).
Scope of deletion: `gh cache delete --all --ref "refs/pull/$PR_NUMBER/merge"` with `--succeed-on-no-caches`. Do not widen the ref or drop the PR-number filter, or caches of other PRs and branches get deleted.
Ordering: delete-caches has `needs: cancel`, so runs are cancelled before caches are removed.
If skipped: widening permissions at top level grants write to every job, and an unscoped delete wipes shared caches. Keep the job at ubuntu-slim with timeout-minutes 5.
Constraints: the GH_TOKEN and REPO come from env, not inline interpolation in the run script.
applies: Changes to the pull_request_target closed/merged cleanup workflow in this repo.
says: Closing a pull request accidentally deleted build caches for other open branches.
Pull request cleanup jobs should only remove caches belonging to the closed contribution.
Shared build caches keep getting wiped out whenever pull requests are merged.
Restrict pipeline cache deletion privileges so automated jobs do not have excess permissions.
Cancel running automated checks before purging saved build caches on pull request closure.
search: In .github/workflows/pr-closed.yml, pull request cleanup keeps top-level permissions denied and restricts actions: write exclusively to the delete-caches job. Cache deletion runs gh cache delete --all --ref refs/pull/$PR_NUMBER/merge with --succeed-on-no-caches to avoid deleting caches of other pull requests or branches. The delete-caches job requires needs: cancel so runs are cancelled before deletion, uses ubuntu-slim with a 5-minute timeout, and passes GH_TOKEN and REPO via environment variables.
